data.body: Implementation landed for review as Gerrit change 2249 (https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/2249). Held-out TDD: backoff schedule tests RED-first then GREEN (cap-removal mutation -> 4 red); workflow-structure test pins the jira-cloud-mutation-probe lane shape. Live-validated against the REB project locally: bridge check-access all 6 steps PASS, both live-Cloud coordinator tests (create/bind lifecycle + fuse pass) PASS, zero leaked issues. Pre-flight: make lint + typecheck + affected units all green. Awaiting LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 before close.
